# Remove previous versions of this apworld from your custom worlds folder

# Twilight Princess v0.4.0

## What's new
- Seed patcher
    - The `.aptp` file is uploaded to https://ap.tprandomizer.com to create a custom seed.
    - Green Ruppes are relpaced with correct items.
    - ISO patching option available 
- Client:
    - every 10s the client will check to make sure you have all the important items you are supposed to have.
    - `/name` is no longer needed as that info is part of the loaded seed. 
- Settings:
    - Options have been updated to replicate the v1.3 settings of the base rando.
- Locations
    - Ruppe and Hidden Ruppes locations have been added to match v1.3 base randomizer.

## Bug fixes
Too many fixes to name, I will just mention a few notable.

- Deathlink no longer hardlocks the game when teleporting
- Removed possible loop when connecting to server causing a spam of packets
- Generation now gives an OptionError if name is not possible for TP to handle (Latin encoding)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WritingHusky/Twilight_Princess_apworld/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0

# Remove previous versions of this apworld from your custom worlds folder

# Twilight Princess v0.4.1

## What's new
### v0.4.1
- Fixed data for multiple locations to send correctly
- Improved wording for TPClient messages
- Added Template yaml to release

### v0.4.0
- Seed patcher
    - The `.aptp` file is uploaded to https://ap.tprandomizer.com to create a custom seed.
    - Green Rupees are replaced with correct items.
    - ISO patching option available 
- Client:
    - every 10s the client will check to make sure you have all the important items you are supposed to have.
    - `/name` is no longer needed as that info is part of the loaded seed. 
- Settings:
    - Options have been updated and added to replicate the v1.3 settings of the base rando.
        - Hyrule Castle Boss Key requirements, Ilia quest shuffle, extended Hyrule castle entrance requirements, and more
- Locations
    - Rupee, Hidden Rupees, Goron Shop (and more) locations have been added to match v1.3 base randomizer.

## Bug fixes
Too many fixes to name, I will just mention a few notable.

- Deathlink no longer hardlocks the game when teleporting
- Removed possible loop when connecting to server causing a spam of packets
- Generation now gives an OptionError if name is not possible for TP to handle (Latin encoding)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/WritingHusky/Twilight_Princess_apworld/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.1
